biotools.summary: SMURF is a deep learning framework that performs soft segmentation of VisiumHD spatial transcriptomic data. It accurately assigns gene transcripts from capture spots to nearby nuclei and unrolls complex tissue architectures for detailed cell-type and gene expression analysis.
